name: endoglin
pathways: negative regulation of SMAD protein signal transduction

function.text: ENG encodes endoglin. Annotated molecular activities include coreceptor activity and protein homodimerization activity. It participates in regulation of DNA-templated transcription and negative regulation of SMAD protein signal transduction.

germline.text: Strong or definitive GenCC assertions link constitutional variants to telangiectasia, hereditary hemorrhagic, type 1 (autosomal dominant).

somatic.text: This gene is included in cancer-panel definitions, but a disease-specific somatic association has not been assigned from the alteration-context sources reviewed for this draft.

germline_associations.mechanism: Autosomal dominant; definitive GenCC assertion from ClinGen. Allele-specific mechanism requires review.
